summary: Source and host facts behind docs/work/openshell-sandbox.md. Host facts and the Zellij default keybindings are live. Release assets were downloaded and checksum-verified but not executed: running the downloaded OpenShell binaries was refused by this session's permission policy, so every OpenShell behaviour below is unvalidated (read from source or docs at the pinned commits).

labels.live: Observed on this host in this run.
labels.unvalidated: Read from OpenShell source or published docs at a pinned commit; not exercised.

sources.local_clones: The maintainer's existing clones were read only and found stale (upstream at 2026-07-22, midstream at 2026-10-09); fresh public clones of both repositories were used instead.

release_assets.provenance: live download, checksum verified, not executed
release_assets.not_executed_reason: Running downloaded third-party binaries was refused by the session permission policy.

zellij_default_keybindings.method: zellij setup --dump-config with private HOME, XDG and ZELLIJ_CONFIG_DIR; no session started
zellij_default_keybindings.not_checked: Zellij 0.44.2 (the other pinned release) was not dumped.

source_facts.fact: The main-process attachment consumes Ctrl-D (0x04) as detach, holds Ctrl-P (0x10) until the next byte, and detaches on Ctrl-P Ctrl-Q (0x11); exec channels are not filtered.

sandbox connect, upload and download run the host OpenSSH client (ssh) with an openshell ProxyCommand; connect forces TERM=xterm-256color. OpenSSH remains a host prerequisite because of upload and download.

sandbox exec does not use ssh: main.rs dispatches it to run::sandbox_exec_grpc, which streams over the gateway ExecSandboxInteractive gRPC call when stdin is a terminal (unary ExecSandbox otherwise) while the openshell CLI process holds the local TTY in crossterm raw mode. ssh::sandbox_exec is re-exported but has no caller. The sandbox side sets TERM=xterm-256color for a PTY and dumb otherwise.
rule get has no --output flag and prints labelled human-readable lines only.
sandbox create --upload conflicts with a trailing command; sandboxes are kept by default; --approval-mode accepts manual or auto and defaults to manual.
crates/openshell-cli/src/main.rs is byte-identical between v0.1.6 and upstream main ba302a6, and the midstream has no changes under crates/ relative to its upstream merge base.
source_facts.where: git diff v0.1.6 ba302a6 -- crates/openshell-cli/src/main.rs; git diff 634ca7d8 71b5bdbf -- crates proto python

source_facts.fact: Host-gateway aliases (host.openshell.internal, host.containers.internal, host.docker.internal) get a trusted SSRF exemption only for a link-local pinned address; loopback is always blocked by network policy.
The CLI source has no telemetry call sites; telemetry is a default-on gateway feature disabled with OPENSHELL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false or compiled out.
Midstream Konflux images build the gateway and supervisor with --no-default-features --features defaults-without-telemetry; the midstream Helm chart default stays telemetryEnabled: true.
The midstream CLI is built dynamically against glibc into a container image (odh-openshell-cli) rather than published as GitHub release binaries.
The openshell Python package is Alpha and depends on cloudpickle, grpcio, googleapis-common-protos, httpx and protobuf.

not_run: openshell or openshell-prover binaries (refused by the session permission policy)
